Practised estimating a large collection using a known group as a guide.
Discussed grouping objects and comparing an estimate with the actual amount.
Ananya first mixed up 10 × 3 as 103 or 13, then corrected it to 30.
They explained that an estimate is a guess without counting that is close to the actual number.
Teach-back was not fully passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using known groups to make a sensible estimate. Ananya explained the meaning of estimate and corrected the mix-up between 103, 13, and 30 later in the lesson. At home, show a small collection of objects, make groups of 5 or 10, and ask Ananya to estimate before counting.
